papers.title: Artificial intelligence predictor of circular economy actions in the social economy
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Corporate social responsibility (CSR) encompasses companies’ voluntary actions that integrate economic, social, and environmental concerns into their operations. Concurrently, the circular economy (CE) has emerged as a transformative organizational paradigm that replaces the traditional linear “take-make-dispose” model with a regenerative system to minimize waste and optimize resource use. This study harnessed artificial intelligence (AI) as a tool for predicting circular practices and exploring how CSRI can indicate organizations’ orientation toward CE principles. To this end, the research conducted partial least squares (PLS) structural equation modeling using SmartPLS software to analyze a sample of 129 social economy organizations in Spain. The findings confirm the validity of the proposed causal relationships and demonstrate the potential of AI-assisted analytical approaches for modeling complex constructs. Overall, the results contribute to the literature on the intersection of CSR and CE by providing theoretical and practical insights into how digital technologies can facilitate the transition from linear to circular business models in the social economy sector.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融科技】摘要  
企业社会责任（CSR）是指企业自愿将经济、社会和环境因素融入其运营中的行为。与此同时，循环经济（CE）作为一种变革性的组织范式应运而生，它摒弃了传统的线性“获取-制造-处置”模式，转而采用再生系统以减少浪费并优化资源利用。本研究利用人工智能（AI）来预测企业的循环经济实践，并探讨企业社会责任（CSRI）如何反映企业对循环经济原则的认同程度。为此，研究采用SmartPLS软件进行了偏最小二乘（PLS）结构方程建模，分析了西班牙129家社会经济组织的数据。研究结果验证了所提出的因果关系的有效性，并展示了AI辅助分析方法在处理复杂概念时的潜力。总体而言，这些发现为CSR与循环经济的交叉研究领域做出了贡献，提供了关于数字技术如何促进社会经济领域从线性商业模式向循环经济模式转型的理论和实践见解。。

papers.title: The Application of the Contributory Negligence Doctrine in Determining Bank Liability for Customer Losses
papers.venue: International Journal of Business Law and Education
papers.abstract: This article examines the legal consequences of applying the contributory negligence doctrine to bank liability for customer losses arising from errors, negligence, or misconduct committed by bank employees. The central issue is whether a bank, as a financial services business actor, may rely on customer fault to exclude liability even when the loss is causally connected to employee conduct performed within the bank's operational sphere. Using normative legal research, this article applies statutory, conceptual, and case approaches to Indonesian civil law, banking regulation, financial consumer protection norms, and selected court decisions. The analysis focuses on Article 10 of Financial Services Authority Regulation Number 22 of 2023 on Consumer and Public Protection in the Financial Services Sector, the Indonesian Civil Code, the Banking Law, and relevant dispute-resolution mechanisms. The findings indicate that banks bear prima facie responsibility for losses caused by employees, directors, commissioners, or third parties acting on behalf of the bank. Article 10(2), which allows financial services providers to avoid liability when consumer involvement or negligence is proven, functionally resembles contributory negligence. However, an absolute or all-or-nothing application of that provision is difficult to reconcile with the structural imbalance between banks and customers, the prudential principle, and modern financial consumer protection standards. The article argues that Indonesian banking liability should be interpreted through a proportional model closer to comparative negligence, so that customer fault may reduce but should not automatically extinguish bank liability where employee negligence remains a substantial cause of loss.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文探讨了将“共同过失原则”应用于银行因员工错误、疏忽或不当行为导致的客户损失责任时的法律后果。核心问题是：作为金融服务企业，银行是否可以在损失与员工在银行运营范围内实施的行为存在因果关系的情况下，以客户的过错为由免除自身责任。本文通过规范法律研究，结合印度尼西亚民法典、银行业监管规定、金融消费者保护准则以及相关法院判决，运用了立法、概念分析和案例研究的方法。分析重点包括2023年第22号《金融服务管理局条例》中关于金融服务行业消费者和公共保护的第10条、印度尼西亚民法典、《银行业法》以及相关的争议解决机制。研究结果表明，银行对员工、董事、代理人或代表银行行事的第三方所造成的损失负有初步责任。第10(2)条规定允许金融服务提供者在证明存在客户过错或客户自身疏忽的情况下免除责任，这一规定在功能上类似于“共同过失原则”。然而，对该条款的绝对化或非此即彼的适用方式难以与银行与客户之间的结构性失衡、审慎经营原则以及现代金融消费者保护标准相协调。本文认为，应采用更接近“比较过失原则”的比例性解释方法来界定银行的赔偿责任，即客户的过错可以在一定程度上减轻银行的赔偿责任，但当员工疏忽仍是损失的...。

papers.title: A Declining CVaR Glidepath Framework for Target-Date Fund Design with an Application to the Chilean Pension System
papers.abstract: We propose a framework for designing Target-Date Funds (TDFs) around an explicit return objective while controlling risk directly at the portfolio level through a declining Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) constraint. In this approach, the regulator or sponsor specifies a CVaR glidepath that gives the portfolio manager enough flexibility to reach a target return with a reasonably high probability. The target return is determined exogenously from pension-design inputs such as retirement age, contribution rate, working years, life expectancy, and replacement-rate goals. This differs from conventional TDF design, where age-dependent asset-class limits are set without an explicit link to a required return.   A key feature of the method is that it does not assume the manager selects an optimal portfolio each period. Instead, each month the manager draws an allocation from the set of portfolios satisfying the CVaR constraint. This yields a conservative evaluation of each glidepath: success probabilities are averages over admissible allocations, rather than best-case outcomes. We introduce two figures of merit: the probability of meeting the target return and the cumulative risk assumed over the life of the TDF.   As a proof of concept, we apply the framework to Chile's 2025 pension reform using nine Chilean and global asset classes and a 40-year accumulation horizon. The results show that the transition age at which risk starts to decline is the most consequential design parameter, and that contribution density acts as a hard constraint: below a critical threshold, portfolio design alone cannot compensate for structurally low contributions. The framework is general and can be applied to any TDF designed around an explicit return objective.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】我们提出了一种框架，用于设计目标日期基金（Target-Date Funds, TDFs），该框架在明确设定回报目标的同时，通过实施递减的条件风险价值（Conditional Value-at-Risk, CVaR）约束来直接控制投资组合的风险。在这种方法中，监管机构或发起人会指定一个CVaR下滑路径（CVaR glidepath），为投资组合管理者提供足够的灵活性，以便以较高的概率实现目标回报。目标回报是根据养老金设计的输入参数（如退休年龄、缴费率、工作年限、预期寿命和替代率目标）外生确定的。这与传统的TDF设计方法不同，传统方法中设置的资产类别限制与所需回报之间没有明确的关联。

该方法的一个关键特点是它不假设管理者在每个时期都会选择最优的投资组合。相反，管理者每月从满足CVaR约束的投资组合集合中选取一个进行配置。这种方式对每个下滑路径的评估更为保守：成功概率是基于所有可接受配置的平均值，而非最佳情况的结果。我们引入了两个评估指标：实现目标回报的概率以及TDF整个生命周期内所承担的累积风险。

作为概念验证，我们将该框架应用于智利的2025年养老金改革，使用了九种智利和全球...。

papers.title: Price Elasticity of Gas Demand on L1 and L2: Evidence from Ethereum and Arbitrum
papers.abstract: We estimate the causal price elasticity of gas demand on Ethereum mainnet (L1)   and Arbitrum One (L2), a quantity necessary for calibrating fee mechanism   simulations, evaluating resource pricing reforms, and explaining observed   usage patterns. A two-way fixed effects panel regression instrumented by each   wallet's own lagged base fee removes the congestion-driven endogeneity that   causes naive regressions to substantially underestimate demand sensitivity.   On Ethereum mainnet (full year 2025), the pooled IV elasticity is -0.006***,   near-inelastic: a 10% fee increase reduces total gas demand by approximately   0.06%. On Arbitrum One (October 2025--April 2026), the pooled IV elasticity   is -0.036**. Both chains are inelastic in the aggregate, with L2 measurably   more responsive than L1. A per-resource decomposition of L2 demand reveals   elasticities ranging from modestly elastic computation (-0.027*) to -0.27***   for refunds, with storage growth (-0.15***) and calldata (-0.06*) in between.   Behavioral clustering identifies always-on protocol wallets as near-inelastic   and high-volume operators as substantially more responsive, with cluster-level   elasticities up to roughly 6x the pooled estimate. These results establish an   empirical foundation for downstream simulations and for evaluating fee   mechanism designs.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们估算了以太坊主网（L1）和Arbitrum One（L2）上天然气需求的因果价格弹性，这一数据对于校准费用机制模拟、评估资源定价改革以及解释实际使用模式至关重要。通过使用每个钱包自身延迟后的基础费用作为工具变量，我们消除了由网络拥堵导致的内生性问题，这类问题会导致简单回归方法严重低估需求的敏感性。在以太坊主网（2025年全年数据）中，综合估计的弹性值为-0.006***，属于近乎无弹性的情况：费用增加10%会导致总天然气需求减少约0.06%。在Arbitrum One（2025年10月至2026年4月的数据）中，综合弹性值为-0.036**。总体而言，这两个区块链平台的天然气需求都表现出无弹性特征，但L2的反应更为明显。对L2需求按资源类型进行分解后发现：计算资源的弹性为-0.027*；退款服务的弹性为-0.27***；存储服务的弹性为-0.15***；而调用数据的弹性为-0.06***。行为聚类分析显示，始终处于活跃状态的协议钱包几乎不具备价格弹性，而高交易量的用户对价格变动的反应更为敏感，其群体层面的弹性值最高可达综合估计值的6倍。这些研究结果为后续的模拟分析及费用机制设...。研究方法：回归分析、面板回归、固定效应、数值模拟。

papers.title: ChatGPT and stock returns
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  This paper investigates the dynamic relationship between investor attention to generative artificial intelligence, proxied by Google search trends for ChatGPT, and U.S. equity market dynamics. Utilizing a structural vector autoregression framework with weekly data from December 2022 to February 2026, we analyze the conditional responses of equity returns and trading volumes across four major indices. We document a persistent predictive relationship, where positive shocks to information demand correspond to increased valuations for technology-oriented equities and declining valuations for traditional industrial sectors, indicative of a capital rotation effect. While the incorporation of aggregate stock volumes reveals a consistent decline in macro-level trading activity, supporting an immediate consensus repricing mechanism, supplementary firm-level estimations demonstrate significant volume spikes alongside targeted price movements. This confirms that the observed capital rotation is driven by highly specific, active capital reallocation toward direct AI integrators and away from perceived competitors and legacy physical capital, rather than merely reflecting index concentration. Extending the empirical framework to state-dependent specifications demonstrates that these stock market dynamics are highly conditional on the prevailing macroeconomic environment, including shifts in interest rates, economic activity, oil prices, and exchange rates. Finally, restrictive structural orderings reveal significant weakening in these predictive paths, confirming that information demand and asset pricing are simultaneously determined as interconnected dynamic relationships rather than strict, unidirectional causal effects.
papers.summary_zh:
【资产定价】摘要  
本文研究了投资者对生成式人工智能（以谷歌搜索中ChatGPT的相关趋势为代理指标）的关注度与美国股市动态之间的动态关系。通过使用结构向量自回归模型，并结合2022年12月至2026年2月的周度数据，我们分析了四大主要股指的股价回报和交易量的条件响应。研究发现，信息需求的增加会推动科技类股票的估值上升，而传统工业板块的估值下降，这表明存在资本重新配置的现象。虽然整体股票交易量的变化显示出宏观层面交易活动的持续减少，支持了“即时共识定价机制”的存在，但企业层面的补充数据分析表明，在特定价格变动的同时，交易量会出现显著波动。这进一步证实，资本重新配置主要是由资本向直接应用人工智能技术的公司转移所致，而非仅仅由于指数构成的变化。将实证框架扩展到考虑宏观经济因素的情况后，我们发现股市动态在很大程度上受到利率、经济活动、油价和汇率等宏观经济环境的影响。此外，结构模型的分析结果还显示，这些预测关系存在显著弱化趋势，表明信息需求与资产定价是相互关联的动态过程，而非简单的单向因果关系。。研究方法：回归分析、向量自回归。

papers.title: MEASUREMENT OF INVESTMENT EFFICIENCY IN THE GREEN AGRO-INDUSTRY VALUE CHAIN
papers.abstract: Measurement of investment policy efficiency in the green agribusiness value chain is currently highly valued in connection with sustainable development goals. The return on investment is no longer assessed solely by economic indicators, as responsible investments also require the implementation of opportunities for environmental protection, innovative agriculture, and the organization of a circular economy in food processing. The study proposes a methodology for measuring investment efficiency in the green agro-industrial value chain, based on key indicators of progress.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】在绿色农业产业链中衡量投资政策效率目前备受重视，这与可持续发展目标密切相关。投资回报不再仅通过经济指标来评估，因为负责任的投资还需要在环境保护、创新农业以及食品加工领域的循环经济组织等方面创造机会。本研究提出了一种基于关键进展指标的绿色农业产业链投资效率衡量方法。。

papers.title: Financial Hijrah for Generation Z: Transformation of Mindset, Systems, and Sharia-Based Civilization through the Practitioner Goes to Campus Program with Bank Muamalat Indonesia and Students of the Faculty of Economics and Business, UMHT
papers.abstract: Significant changes in Generation Z's financial behavior are the result of advances in digital technology. Ease of access to digital financial services, online transactions, and instant loan facilities, on the one hand, provides opportunities for increased financial inclusion, but on the other hand, gives rise to consumptive, wasteful behavior, poor financial planning, and a limited understanding of Sharia-based financial principles. These conditions demand strengthening Sharia financial literacy through a more contextual and applicable approach in higher education environments. This study aims to analyze the concept of Generation Z's financial migration as a transformation of mindset, system, and Sharia-based economic civilization through the Practitioner Goes to Campus program with Bank Muamalat Indonesia for students of the Faculty of Economics and Business, University of Muhammadiyah Yogyakarta (UMHT). This study uses a descriptive qualitative approach with a reflective study method on the implementation of academic activities that integrate lecture theory and practical experience in the Sharia banking industry. The study results show that the Practitioner Goes to Campus program is an effective tool for enhancing students' understanding of the importance of financial migration, which encompasses not only the shift to using Islamic financial products but also changes in mindset, economic behavior, and financial orientation based on Islamic values ​​and financial stability. The presence of practitioners from the Islamic banking industry provides a more contextual, relevant, and relevant learning experience for students.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】Z世代财务行为的显著变化源于数字技术的进步。一方面，数字金融服务、在线交易和即时贷款设施的便捷性为提高金融包容性提供了机会；另一方面，这些因素也导致了过度消费、浪费行为、财务规划能力薄弱以及对基于伊斯兰教法的财务原则理解不足的问题。鉴于此，有必要在高等教育环境中采取更具针对性和实用性的方法来加强学生的伊斯兰金融素养。本研究旨在通过印度尼西亚穆阿玛拉特银行（Bank Muamalat Indonesia）与日惹穆罕默迪亚大学（University of Muhammadiyah Yogyakarta, UMHT）经济与商学院合作开展的“实践者进校园”（Practitioner Goes to Campus）项目，分析Z世代财务观念转变的过程，以及这一转变如何影响他们的思维模式、金融体系及基于伊斯兰教法的经济文明。研究采用描述性定性方法，并通过反思性研究手段，探讨了将理论讲授与实际操作相结合的学术活动在伊斯兰银行业中的应用情况。研究结果表明，“实践者进校园”项目有效提升了学生对财务转型重要性的认识，这种转型不仅体现在转向使用伊斯兰金融产品上，还体现在思维方式、经济行为以及基于伊斯兰价...。

papers.title: Aid for reconfiguration: How the EU won multilateral protection of geographical indications
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  This article leverages data on the regional allocation of development aid to test a novel theory: the European Union and several of its member states strategically use and orchestrate aid to support the establishment of Geographical Indications (GIs), such as Kampot pepper in Cambodia. As a result, the recipient countries’ material interests change and they become more supportive of GI protection in the global trade regime. In 2020, this resulted in a multilateral GI register under the Geneva Act, in spite of US opposition. I label this mechanism “aid for reconfiguration”, and argue it is not reducible to aid for policy or aid for trade. Regressions of Geneva Act accessions on GI aid corroborate the hypothesized mechanism. The article complements the GODAD geo-coded aid data by coding the location of aid-sponsored GIs, which are found to be more likely to be located in country leaders’ birth regions, and to lead to pro-GI multilateral policy changes. The findings suggest that sector-relevant aid to leaders’ birth regions is more effective at generating multilateral policies favored by the donors.
papers.summary_zh:
【国际贸易】摘要  
本文利用有关发展援助区域分配的数据，验证了一个新理论：欧盟及其部分成员国通过战略性地使用和协调援助措施，支持地理标志产品（GI）的建立，例如柬埔寨的坎波胡椒（Kampot pepper）。这一过程改变了受援国的物质利益，使它们更倾向于在全球贸易体系中支持地理标志产品的保护。2020年，尽管美国表示反对，各国仍根据《日内瓦法案》建立了多边地理标志产品注册制度。我们将这种机制称为“重组型援助”（aid for reconfiguration），并认为它不能简单地归类为政策援助或贸易援助。对《日内瓦法案》成员国加入情况与地理标志产品援助之间的回归分析进一步证实了这一机制的存在。本文通过编码受援助地理标志产品的具体位置，补充了GODAD地理编码援助数据；研究发现，这些产品更有可能位于国家领导人的出生地区，并推动有利于地理标志产品保护的多边政策变革。研究结果表明，针对领导人出生地区的行业相关援助在推动捐助方支持的多边政策方面更为有效。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Mothers on a mission: exploring mompreneurship and economic empowerment in Kazakhstan
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  This study examines the challenges and opportunities of mompreneurship in Kazakhstan, focusing on women balancing entrepreneurship and motherhood within socio-economic and institutional contexts. Using a cross-sectional quantitative design, data were collected from 520 mompreneurs across major regions. Statistical analyses were conducted using R and Excel, including descriptive statistics, t-tests, ANOVA, and multiple regression. Measurement reliability was confirmed through Cronbach’s Alpha (α = 0.76–0.87) and McDonald’s Omega (ω = 0.78–0.89). To enhance methodological rigor, Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) and Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) were performed, demonstrating acceptable model fit (χ²/df = 2.41, CFI = 0.94, TLI = 0.92, RMSEA = 0.058, SRMR = 0.049). Convergent and discriminant validity were established using Composite Reliability (CR > 0.70), Average Variance Extracted (AVE > 0.50), and HTMT (< 0.85). Common method bias was assessed using Harman’s single-factor test (< 50%), indicating no significant bias. Regression diagnostics confirmed model robustness (R² = 0.37–0.48; VIF < 5). Findings reveal that government support, digital technology usage, and access to finance significantly influence entrepreneurial outcomes, while work–family balance remains a persistent constraint. Despite structural barriers, digitalization and evolving policy frameworks create new opportunities for flexible and home-based entrepreneurship. The study contributes by integrating institutional, technological, and life-course perspectives within the context of emerging economies. However, the study is limited by sample scope and cross-sectional design, suggesting the need for longitudinal and comparative research to enhance generalizability and policy relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
【资产定价】摘要  
本研究探讨了哈萨克斯坦女性创业所面临的挑战与机遇，重点关注女性在社会经济与制度背景下如何兼顾创业与母亲角色。采用横断面定量研究方法，从该国主要地区的520位女性创业者中收集数据。数据分析通过R语言和Excel软件完成，包括描述性统计、t检验、方差分析（ANOVA）及多元回归分析。测量信度通过Cronbach’s Alpha（α = 0.76–0.87）和McDonald’s Omega（ω = 0.78–0.89）进行验证。为提升研究方法严谨性，还进行了探索性因子分析（EFA）与验证性因子分析（CFA），结果显示模型拟合度良好（χ²/df = 2.41，CFI = 0.94，TLI = 0.92，RMSEA = 0.058，SRMR = 0.049）。收敛效度和区分效度通过复合信度（CR > 0.70）、平均提取方差（AVE > 0.50）及HTMT（< 0.85）指标得到验证。Harman单因子检验表明不存在显著的方法偏差（< 50%）。回归诊断结果显示模型具有较好的稳健性（R² = 0.37–0.48，VIF < 5）。研究发现，政府支持、数字技术的应用以及融资渠道...。研究方法：回归分析、横截面分析。

papers.title: Pengaruh Kualitas Produk dan Harga terhadap Keputusan Pembelian pada Toko Vivi Jilbab di Sungai Kambang Jambi
papers.abstract: The rapid development of the Muslim fashion industry in Indonesia has intensified competition among local hijab businesses, making it necessary for business actors to understand the factors that influence consumers’ purchasing decisions. However, studies that specifically examine the effects of product quality and price on local Muslim fashion businesses remain relatively limited. This study aims to analyze the effects of product quality and price on consumers’ purchasing decisions at Toko Vivi Jilbab Sungai Kambang Jambi. This study used a quantitative approach with a causal design. The research population consisted of 48,130 consumers, with a sample of 100 respondents determined using the Slovin formula and purposive sampling technique. Data were collected through questionnaires and analyzed using multiple linear regression with the assistance of IBM SPSS Statistics 32. The results showed that product quality had a positive and significant effect on purchasing decisions (t = 5.439; p < 0.001), while price also had a positive and significant effect on purchasing decisions (t = 3.021; p = 0.003). Simultaneously, product quality and price had a positive and significant effect on purchasing decisions (F = 91.028; p < 0.001), with an Adjusted R² value of 0.645. Product quality was the most dominant factor influencing consumers’ purchasing decisions. The conclusion of this study affirms that purchasing decisions are formed through consumers’ evaluation of product benefits and the appropriateness of the prices offered. The implications of this study indicate the importance of maintaining product quality and implementing competitive pricing strategies to increase purchasing decisions and strengthen the competitiveness of local hijab businesses.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】印度尼西亚穆斯林时尚产业的快速发展加剧了当地头巾企业的竞争压力，因此企业需要了解影响消费者购买决策的各种因素。然而，专门研究产品质量和价格对当地穆斯林时尚企业影响的相关文献仍然较为有限。本研究旨在分析产品质量和价格对Jambi省Sungai Kambang地区Toko Vivi Jilbab商店消费者购买决策的影响。研究采用定量方法及因果设计，研究对象为48,130名消费者，通过Slovin公式和目的性抽样技术选取了100名受访者。数据通过问卷收集，并利用IBM SPSS Statistics 32软件进行多元线性回归分析。结果表明：产品质量对消费者的购买决策具有显著的正向影响（t = 5.439；p < 0.001），价格同样对购买决策具有显著的正向影响（t = 3.021；p = 0.003）；同时，产品质量和价格共同对购买决策产生显著的正向影响（F = 91.028；p < 0.001），调整后的R²值为0.645。其中，产品质量是影响消费者购买决策的最主要因素。研究结论表明，消费者的购买决策基于他们对产品价值及价格合理性的评估。本研究启示人们：维持产品质量并实施具有竞争力...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Financial knowledge, skills, and attitudes as predictors of traders’ financial literacy
papers.abstract:
Purpose: to investigate whether financial knowledge, financial skill, and financial attitude serve as significant predictors of financial literacy among traders at Gedhe Market Solo.
Method: this study adopted a quantitative, cross-sectional research design. Primary data were collected through questionnaires from 113 traders at Gedhe Market Solo, selected through random sampling. The data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares–Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS to assess the effects of financial knowledge, financial skill, and financial attitude on financial literacy.
Findings: financial knowledge, financial skill, and financial attitude significantly and positively influence financial literacy among traders. Financial knowledge was found to be the most influential factor, followed by financial attitude and financial skill. These results highlight the importance of enhancing traders’ knowledge, skills, and attitudes to improve their financial literacy.
Implications: efforts to improve traders’ financial literacy should focus on strengthening financial knowledge, financial skills, and financial attitudes through targeted financial education and training programs.
Originality: lies in its focus on traditional market traders at Gedhe Market Solo and its comprehensive examination of financial knowledge, financial skill, and financial attitude as predictors of financial literacy.
papers.summary_zh:
【国际贸易】**目的**：探讨财务知识、财务技能和财务态度是否是Solo Gedhe市场交易者金融素养的重要预测因素。  
**方法**：本研究采用定量、横断面研究设计。通过随机抽样从Solo Gedhe市场的113名交易者中收集问卷数据，并利用SmartPLS软件中的偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析财务知识、财务技能和财务态度对金融素养的影响。  
**结果**：财务知识、财务技能和财务态度对交易者的金融素养具有显著且积极的影响，其中财务知识是最重要的影响因素，其次是财务态度和财务技能。这些结果表明，提升交易者的知识、技能和态度对于提高其金融素养至关重要。  
**启示**：提高交易者金融素养的努力应侧重于通过有针对性的金融教育和培训项目来强化他们的财务知识、财务技能和财务态度。  
**创新性**：本研究聚焦于Solo Gedhe市场的传统市场交易者，并全面考察了财务知识、财务技能和财务态度作为金融素养预测因素的作用。。研究方法：横截面分析。

papers.title: Semiparametric Local Projections
papers.abstract: We propose a semiparametric local projection estimator of nonlinear impulse response functions for a broad class of structural dynamic models relevant for applied macroeconomics, including models with nonlinearly transformed regressors, state dependent coefficients, and nonlinear interactions between shocks and state variables. The estimator is based on a doubly robust moment condition that identifies the average response function as a linear functional of a nonparametric conditional mean, augmented by a density ratio that captures the effect of shifting the shock of interest. We combine this moment condition with cross-fitting that handles serial dependence. The resulting estimator is $\sqrt{T}$-consistent and asymptotically normal. We examine the finite-sample performance of the estimator across a range of nonlinear data generating processes and illustrate its use in two empirical examples.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种半参数局部投影估计方法，用于估计非线性脉冲响应函数。该方法适用于广泛应用于宏观经济学中的各类结构动态模型，包括那些具有非线性变换自变量、状态依赖系数以及冲击与状态变量之间存在非线性交互作用的模型。该估计方法基于一个双重稳健的矩条件，该条件将平均响应函数表示为非参数条件均值的线性函数，并通过引入一个密度比来捕捉感兴趣的冲击发生位置变化所带来的影响。我们将这一矩条件与处理序列依赖性的交叉拟合技术相结合，从而得到一个具有$\sqrt{T}$一致性的估计量，且该估计量在渐近意义上服从正态分布。我们通过一系列非线性数据生成过程检验了该估计量的有限样本性能，并在两个实证案例中展示了其应用效果。。
